class: external synthethic falsification; no native Yggdrasil training or protected first use
hypothesis: Old-to-new persistence of learned AND/XOR primitive subexpressions improves unseen-cold causal consequence prediction at least 5 percent over conventional same-feature-bank nonlinear regressors and matched OMP softmax memory, on freshly generated five-variable compositional mechanisms.

excluded_development.notes: Development pilot scored BEFORE source freeze; scorer changed afterward to add softmax memory; source freeze and prereg preceded the new prospective seeds. Development data excluded.

test.observation_data: Each world has 8 randomized causal action bits and 2 nuisance observed bits with OLD/NEW correlations and independent COLD values; 7 hidden distinct causal role IDs. Actions are 224 unique eight-bit causal do assignments: 64 OLD train + 64 NEW train +32 held OLD +32 held NEW +32 held COLD; consequences contain a signed 2-bit XOR shared mechanism, another old or new nested 5-bit mechanism from author-designed conditional5/nested_xor5/threshold5, and Gaussian noise sigma .18. No roles or held labels enter fitting.
test.candidate: Preserve old OMP5 head; learn 17 top correlated unary/pair AND/XOR primitives OLD and NEW; synthesize a NEW shared bank of unary/pair atoms plus AND/XOR pairs of non-overlapping selected primitive parents (using seven retained OLD and fourteen NEW parents); greedily fit 5-term NEW predictor with 1.12 bias to previously old-selected features. Only primitive operators supplied: no pre-listed five-bit generator high-level operators. Finite bounded search, not autonomous operator invention.
controls: Fresh fully fitted conventional OMP5 on EXACT SAME synthesized feature bank
Fully fitted ElasticNet alpha=.025 l1_ratio=.85 on SAME feature bank
Fully fitted Ridge alpha=3 on SAME feature bank
Conventional temperature .10 softmax weighting of OLD and NEW fitted OMP5 using train NEW labels
Fully fitted RBF KernelRidge alpha=.3 gamma=.19
Fully fitted ExtraTrees n_estimators=48 max_depth=9 min_leaf=2
Shuffled new training labels then same-bank OMP5
test.information_parity: All methods receive exactly the same witnessed 64 old and 64 new action/consequence observations, no extra selected actions, no evaluation truth or hidden roles; trained controls can differ in computational capacity but same-bank controls see exactly same constructed features.
test.evaluation: Unweighted world-mean held prediction MSE for 32 OLD/NEW/COLD queries; per-seed and per-family cold MSE, composed-expression selection count, full per-world held prediction vectors and training labels retained for source-disjoint auditor. Audit independently implements generator and refits all arms, shares NumPy/sklearn third-party solvers.
test.budget: 24 new screening worlds, single-thread Linux CPU Python 3.13.5 NumPy 2.3.5 sklearn 1.8.0, one unchanged-source replay and independent audit. No API cost, privileged runner or physical Joule claim.

frozen_gates.cold_vs_strongest_conventional_5pct: Candidate pooled COLD MSE <=0.95 times MINIMUM across fresh OMP, same-bank ElasticNet/Ridge, softmax memory, KernelRidge, ExtraTrees and primitive OMP pooled cold MSE.
frozen_gates.cold_vs_same_bank_elasticnet_5pct: Candidate pooled COLD MSE <=0.95x same-bank fully trained ElasticNet cold MSE.
frozen_gates.cold_vs_softmax_memory_5pct: Candidate pooled COLD MSE <=0.95x conventional OMP softmax memory cold MSE.
frozen_gates.cold_vs_same_bank_omp_5pct: Candidate pooled COLD MSE <=0.95x same bank fresh fully fitted OMP5 cold MSE.
frozen_gates.win_each_screen_seed: Candidate mean cold MSE < best conventional pooled seed cold MSE on BOTH prospective screen seeds.
frozen_gates.family_noninferiority_10pct: Candidate family cold MSE <=1.10x BEST same-bank conventional family cold MSE in ALL three families.
frozen_gates.old_readout_frozen_exact: Candidate OLD held MSE == old_no_update OLD held MSE within 1e-12 for all 24 worlds.
frozen_gates.shuffled_negative_20pct: Candidate pooled COLD MSE <=0.8x shuffled new outcome control COLD MSE.
frozen_gates.composition_exercised_20pct: At least ceil(0.20*24)=5 of the 24 worlds select at least one synthetically composed term (index>=100).
frozen_gates.new_cold_vs_old_no_update_20pct: Candidate pooled COLD MSE <=0.8x frozen OLD no-update predictor COLD MSE.

decisions.SCREEN_PROMISING: All FIRST FOUR critical gates PASS, win_each_screen_seed PASS, >=8/10 gates PASS, complete independent model refit audit PASS. Only this permits separate 36-world primary with already reserved seeds, not automatic promotion.
decisions.SCREEN_NO_GO: At least ONE critical gate or win_each_screen_seed FAIL or total PASS <8 (valid audit); archive result, halt reserved primary, do not retune consumed screens.
decisions.INVALID: Prereg or source not present prior to first evaluation, mismatched source hash or training/held separation, incomplete source-independent audit, missing strong control, contaminated labels, or changed post-result seed/threshold
decisions.UNVERIFIED: If runtime/CI/audit incomplete, no scientific pass/no go claim
decisions.SCIENTIFIC_PASS: Not in scope; external screening cannot establish native learning, real operator invention or scientific acceptance.

restrictions: No postscore tuning and no reuse of consumed seed for promotion
No controller, owner scheduler, runner or queue execution
No paid API or energy efficiency claim
Do not consume reserved primary if screen fails
